title: Look-ahead carry generator

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, SN54182/SN74182 (bulletin DL-S 7611823, Dec 1972, rev. Oct 1976)

pins.name: G0'
pins.text: carry generate input, active low (alternative name Y0)

functions.text: Datasheet equation, with G0 = NOT G0', P0 = NOT P0'. Function table: high when G0' low, or P0' low and Cn high; low otherwise.

functions.formula: Cn+y = G1 OR (P1 AND G0) OR (P1 AND P0 AND Cn)
functions.text: Datasheet equation (G = NOT G', P = NOT P').

functions.formula: Cn+z = G2 OR (P2 AND G1) OR (P2 AND P1 AND G0) OR (P2 AND P1 AND P0 AND Cn)
functions.text: Datasheet equation (G = NOT G', P = NOT P').

functions.formula: G' = NOT (G3 OR (P3 AND G2) OR (P3 AND P2 AND G1) OR (P3 AND P2 AND P1 AND G0))
functions.text: Datasheet: G' = (G3 + P3G2 + P3P2G1 + P3P2P1G0)'. Low when the group generates a carry.

functions.formula: P' = NOT (P3 AND P2 AND P1 AND P0)
functions.text: Low only when P3', P2', P1', P0' are all low.

electrical.notes: SN74182 recommended: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, IOH -800 uA, IOL 16 mA, TA 0-70 C. Inputs load unequally: IIL Cn -3.2 mA, P3' -4.8, P2' -6.4, P0'/P1'/G3' -8, G0'/G2' -14.4, G1' -16 mA (several standard loads).

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm; the datasheet gives one figure for all paths
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm; the datasheet gives one figure for all paths

unknown: No minimum propagation delays printed (path-delay function uses 0 ns).
notes: The same circuit serves active-high data with the alternative names Y0-Y3, X0-X3, Cn', Y, X: Cn+x' = (Y0(X0 + Cn))' etc., as printed on page 7-282.
